# pcd_networking_quota (Resource)

Manages the Neutron (networking) quotas for a project. Use `-1` for unlimited. Only the quota fields you set are managed; fields you omit keep their server value. Destroying this resource stops managing the quotas but does not reset them to their defaults.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pcd_identity_project" "demo" {
  name = "demo"
}

resource "pcd_networking_quota" "example" {
  project_id     = data.pcd_identity_project.demo.id
  network        = 20
  port           = 200
  router         = 10
  subnet         = 20
  security_group = 20
  floatingip     = 50
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The project (tenant) the quotas apply to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `floatingip` (Number) Quota for the number of floating IPs.
- `network` (Number) Quota for the number of networks.
- `port` (Number) Quota for the number of ports.
- `rbac_policy` (Number) Quota for the number of RBAC policies.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `router` (Number) Quota for the number of routers.
- `security_group` (Number) Quota for the number of security groups.
- `security_group_rule` (Number) Quota for the number of security group rules.
- `subnet` (Number) Quota for the number of subnets.
- `subnetpool` (Number) Quota for the number of subnet pools.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The composite `<project_id>/<region>` ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_networking_quota.example <project_id>/<region>
```
